title: ADRIA-synthetic-data
summary: A data-generation toolkit that builds synthetic input data layers (site data, coral cover, environmental wave/DHW, and connectivity data) for the ADRIA coral reef intervention model. It fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata on real ecological data and evaluates the outputs with SDV/sdmetrics quality and diagnostic reports, while also using DeepEcho's PARModel for sequential environmental data, making SDV and its sibling libraries the core synthesis and validation engine.
